verified_rules: entity search supports json html and geojson extensions
coordinate queries return selected-dataset entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point
UPRN can be supplied through q and is described as more precise than coordinate lookup for registered properties
WKT geometry queries use WGS84 EPSG:4326 and geometry_relation controls the spatial predicate
offset and limit paginate results and response links provide next prev first and last URLs
the API has no portfolio batch endpoint and official guidance recommends bulk downloads for large workloads
bulk dataset pages can provide CSV JSON GeoJSON and Parquet snapshots
field parameters can reduce the response payload
absence of results does not prove absence of constraints because geographic coverage varies
the API remains beta and production consumers must tolerate change
